title: Equity in the Use of ChatGPT for the Classroom: A Comparison of the Accuracy and Precision of ChatGPT 3.5 vs. ChatGPT4 with Respect to Statistics and Data Science Exams
reasoning: The paper focuses on the educational equity implications of the performance gap between free and paid versions of ChatGPT. While it discusses the 'digital divide' as an ethical concern in education, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
